independent_checks: The immutable plan contains exactly two SHARED anchor R2 specs and zero B units; both spec files hash to its index and neither R2 unit is in S3 queue state.
Each spec names its distinct completed original feature-anchor parent, whose S3 queue receipt, ANCHOR_RECEIPT and archived fit-lock SHA match the committed R2 lock.
Each exact r1/r2/pair reader receipt map equals both the R2 lock and the actual hash-pinned parent ANCHOR_RECEIPT; each referenced reader receipt file matches its SHA.
Each spec names the exact R2 runner SHA, seed, --unit-id, control lock, local seal, data manifest, versioned private output, single-thread environment, 600-second wall/CPU reserve and 2 GiB RSS cap.
Both versioned output paths are absent before enqueue. S3 independently reports local V2 seal PASS and no admission/parent rejection for the same two specs.
limitations: This audit reads metadata and hashes only. It does not attest to V2 Adult probe outputs, any task or SEX endpoint, or population confidence.
S3 must refresh global external-job occupancy and resource headroom immediately before launch; the queue must revalidate the parent/spec/lock at enqueue and launch.
The original anchor s0 V2 pre-role failure and unrun original s1 remain preserved under the prior lock. The 16 B V2 outputs remain bound to that prior lock.
Independent S4 Adult numerical replay requires a separate admission and queue mode.
